# Lastloved / 그때그곡 / あの頃の曲 / 当年那首歌

> A private log for the song you are wearing out right now: title, artist, the day you last loved it, and how many years until it comes back to you. No account, no login, no streaming service, no audio files, no song-count lock. Everything stays on the device.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://lastloved.try-dabble.com/
Songs, dates, year counts and the default wait are stored in this browser only (localStorage keys lastloved:songs:v1 and lastloved:years:v1). No accounts, no subscription, no server-side storage, no sharing.

This is NOT a music player and NOT a streaming client. There is no play button, no audio file picker and no Spotify, Apple Music or YouTube connection. A song here is a title and an artist that you typed.

## Pages

- [Home](https://lastloved.try-dabble.com/): The shelf — songs that are back now, and songs still waiting
- [Privacy](https://lastloved.try-dabble.com/privacy.html): Privacy policy
- [Terms](https://lastloved.try-dabble.com/terms.html): Terms of use
- [Guide](https://try-dabble.com/guides/lastloved): How-to on try-dabble.com

## Features

- Add a song by typing a title and an artist; both are required, and that is all it takes
- Date last loved, defaulting to today and editable at any time
- Choose how many years until it comes back: 1, 2, 3, 5, 10, or any number up to 50
- The number you pick is remembered as the default for the next song
- Songs whose years have passed appear in their own "back now" list, above the ones still waiting
- Each song carries a year stamp showing the year it returns
- One tap to mark a song heard again, which winds the clock back to today and counts the reunion
- Search across titles and artists
- Delete a song, with confirmation
- No login, no sign-up, no credit-card screen, no subscription or IAP
- No 10-song or 100-song lock, and no music-library requirement
- No streaming account, no play button, no audio files
- Data survives closing the tab and closing the browser; nothing expires on a clock
- Multi-language UI: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese
- Installable PWA with a network-first service worker
